function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

message.content:
**Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)** *Location:* 1 Airport Blvd, Miami, FL 33126 (just outside Miami International Airport) | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Train services** | Amtrak (Silver Service), Tri‑Rail, and the Florida East Coast Railway (Freight) | | **Pet policy** | • Pets are allowed in the station premises (including the waiting areas, restrooms, and the pet‑relief area).
• On Amtrak trains, pets are permitted in the cabin for a small fee (check Amtrak’s pet‑policy page for exact fees and restrictions).
• Tri‑Rail allows pets on board for a nominal fee; check Tri‑Rail’s website for current rules. | | **Pet‑relief area** | Dedicated pet‑relief station located near the main entrance, equipped with waste bags and a small water bowl. | | **Accessibility** | Fully ADA‑compliant with elevators, ramps, and tactile signage. | | **Hours** | 24/7 operation (train schedules vary). | | **Amenities** | Restrooms, vending machines, Wi‑Fi, a small café, and a pet‑friendly waiting lounge. | | **Contact** | Phone: (305) 274‑4000 (MIA Customer Service)
Website: https://www.miamiintermodalcenter.com/ | **Why it’s a good choice for pet owners** - **Central hub:** Connects to major rail lines (Amtrak, Tri‑Rail) and the Metrorail, making it easy to transfer between modes of transport. - **Pet‑friendly environment:** The station’s pet‑relief area and clear signage help keep the space clean and comfortable for both pets and passengers. - **Convenient location:** Right next to Miami International Airport, so you can drop off or pick up your pet at the same place you handle flights. - **24/7 access:** Even if you’re traveling late at night or early in the morning, the station remains open. If you’re planning a trip that involves a train ride from Miami and you’re bringing a pet, the Miami Intermodal Center is the most reliable, pet‑friendly station in the city.
